items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And that same day he came out, he met a fellow named Leroy; I don't know Leroy's last name.

ctx.x: Yeah. I would hate to say that on this tape. But it was somebody who was close to him who turned him on to drugs when he was fourteen years old -- hard drugs. And then he told me about this book that his mother left him in his room one time about inhibitions, you know. And he said she never really got on his case, you know; she would just do these different things. She loved him. She was a nurse. She loved him, and she was just trying to guide him the best she could without really being harsh toward him, you know.

Finally, he got the date for his release from Camarillo, and everybody was really planning a big coming-out party for him. Heh-heh... I'll never forget it, it was on a Monday. And that same day he came out, he met a fellow named Leroy; I don't know Leroy's last name. But anyway,
